title: Sanjhbati
desc: An elderly woman struggles with her difficult nature and isolated life. When a new caretaker arrives, their relationship faces challenges, developing into a story about connection and companionship.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Cheetah
desc: Jamal, a gangster, kills Amar's family. To everyone's surprise, the latter survives, wakes from a coma and seeks revenge.

title: Jwar Bhata
desc: Bijay, a rich tea estate owner's son, angers his father when he marries a poor girl. Ranjan, his cousin, tries to make the most of the situation by usurping his property.

title: Satarupa
desc: Dr. Rupa unintentionally causes Shatadal's memory loss, leading him to see her as his only kin. Later, they fall for each other but when his past returns, he forgets her.

title: Agnipath
desc: Sujay, Ajay and Bijay are three siblings who share a close bond and can go to any length to protect each other. However, when Sujay is killed by his own boss, Bijay sets out to exact revenge.
